# Stage STDO 3.0.4 for the successor default library

Owner approved this bounded RC5 scope. Invoke the exact local .claude/skills/stdo-work/SKILL.md as recipient under NATIVE_GRANT.json. Start with this task/grant, the existing default-library HOW and declaration. Source development uses STDO3.0.4; immutable installed RC4 is the builder on3.0.2. Do not rewrite prior Runs, artifacts or history.

Implement the smallest successor declaration using original manifest102817a3...a9f95b, exact released members and recomputed complete heading spans. Bind the four existing roles through the same generic run-environment declaration/inventory/acquisition/assembly owners. Retain Executive/Worker/Reviewer/Assurance responsibility; add task-applicable native stdo-work (selector, constructor, command executor) and stdo-review (assessor) source bindings and the required reference closure. Explicitly declare the finite role-to-skill/source selection in the owning HOW before implementing it. Pack immutable original bytes; do not reinterpret skills as Product authority, register a new actor, bypass specialized full-source validation, or create a loader/store/controller. Not all available skills need be selected for every role. Membership/byte/span validation must cover plugin members as well as standards against their original selected manifest; use the existing generator's finite owner checks, not a second runtime. Missing/mismatched selected bytes refuse.

C2 compiles your candidate first, copies ONLY compiled DEFAULT_LIBRARY_STDO_SOURCE.manifest/members from the pinned304 input to their declared assetPaths, invokes the existing qualification staging owner against the exact current Definition/spec and release, then the existing product generator. You own the declaration/member paths and any necessary minimal generator adaptation. Do not run generators on canonical source or manually edit generated contracts: their exact C2 products are adopted later by Root under the existing source-correspondence procedure. Current canonical contracts remain historical302 until that adoption. The C2 recipe is immutable operator input. The source/default library tests must demonstrate exact selected304 bytes/spans/role context and preserve genuine altered/missing/unpermitted acquisition refusal. Retained302 and selected304 qualification source fixtures are supplied; old fixture keys retain their literal names with explicit real identities. No skip counts as proof of the selected migration. Existing unrelated capture/live-only cases remain unselected, separately reported.

Extend only affected tests as needed and update the existing HOW/computational binding for this completed declaration migration. GC03 is an independently pinned historical host-adapter supplement; no host rewrite is selected. The feature set, Public contracts and generic environment owner semantics stay fixed. F4 codec repair is the next separately selected native increment. If your required realization cannot fit the exact grant, return the missing owner relation; do not silently broaden it.

One coherent Construction then actual Testing and UAT. Avoid broad rereading, repeated archaeology or an extra design call once this bounded HOW decision is expressed. Ordinary private implementation choices are yours. Optional noEmit/syntax checks use the existing read-only offline dependency link. Do not build/package/install on canonical source. Save exact changed paths, chosen role/source map, local checks and remaining exclusions to rc5-scratch/method-01/return.json; retain useful short readiness evidence in readiness.json and remove only your own disposable scratch files. Return at the declared boundary. Independent source review, C2 output correspondence and Root acceptance follow.

Focused selection: C2 runs the existing exact role-content case and every new case named with prefix "RC5 STDO 3.0.4" in t287-default-library.test.mjs, plus the run-environment and qualification-law suites. Do not rerun unrelated native recovery/live/capture tests. Ensure new migration negatives and role-content coverage carry that exact prefix. Existing stdo3-run-environment fixtures are explicit retained302 controls, not304 proof. Selected304 tests must exercise the actual new member/skill closure.
